entities.name: Léon Zack
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Léon Zack (1892–1980), also known as Lev Vasilyevich Zak, was a Russian-born French figurative and later abstract painter and sculptor. He has been described as a School of Paris painter. Zack was also a Russian-language Futurist poet using the pseudonyms Khrisanf and M. Rossiyansky.
